_comment: What ci/gates/parity.py emits against each tree here. Machine-readable because prose in GATE.md is not a declaration: a stated count nothing checks drifts the moment a case is added.

cases: go-lint: the two invocations of `golangci-lint run` differ
.github/workflows/test.yml:mix format --check-formatted: invokes the checking tool `mix` directly
.github/workflows/scheduled.yml: invokes `make check-gates` only under a condition
.github/workflows/scheduled.yml: does not invoke `python3 ci/parity.py` -- no step's `run:` body executes it
elixir-warnings-are-errors: .github/workflows/test.yml invokes no `mix compile` at the declared site
elixir-format: .github/workflows/test.yml invokes no `mix format` at the declared site
fast-tier-budget: .github/workflows/test.yml invokes no `python3 ci/fast-tier.py` at the declared site
go-lint: .github/workflows/test.yml invokes no `golangci-lint run` at the declared site
.github/workflows/scheduled.yml: declared as the recurring runner and absent

invocations._why: The report-only mode every gate takes. Declared because GATE.md shows it, and a demonstration the repository documents and never performs is the case ci/gates/fixture_declarations.py exists for.
